external_implication.source: Rifat Jumagulov, The Hodge conjecture for Fermat fourfolds of odd degree at most 199, arXiv:2608.18134v1 (2026), Theorem 1.2
external_implication.implication: A Hodge (2,2) character whose multiset splits into two zero-sum triples has algebraic rational Hodge block via the Shioda-Katsura joining-line correspondence and Lefschetz (1,1).

research_state_change: The two m=39 residual orbits should no longer be carried as open transport/projection obligations when this external theorem is admitted. They become externally proved calibration/closed cases.
claim_ceiling: The local execution verifies only the theorem hypothesis. The algebraicity conclusion is source-dependent on the external theorem and is not independently reproved here. No P-vs-NP evidence is involved.
